senses.gloss: ch. same, to break, smash, crumble.—Part. pass. פְּרִיךְ, פְּרִיכָא crushed; peeling, brittle.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 4:8">Targ. Lam. IV, 8</cite> (h. text <cite ref="J00069"><he>יבש</he></cite>, v.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 8">Lev. R. s. 8</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="A02876"><he>אַצִּיל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 68b:4">Pes. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>יבשה מִפְּרִיךְ פ׳</he> a dry wart is scraped off (and not cut).
B. Mets. 70ᵃ דהבא פ׳ broken gold-ware (gold dust); B. Bath. 166ᵃ; a. fr.—Trnsf. to refute, raise an objection.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 5b">B. Kam. 5ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>דאיכא למִיפְרַךְ וכ׳</he> it may be objected (against this analogy) &c.; v. infra.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="Q01844">same</cite>. [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 3:3">Targ. Koh. III, 3</cite>. v. <cite ref="Q00924"><he>פְּכַר</he></cite>.) <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 33:52">Targ. Y. II, Num. XXXIII, 52</cite> <he>תְּפָרְכוּן</he> (not <he>תתפ׳</he>).—Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ bot. <he>כד מְפָרֵךְ ברישייא</he> when he husks the heads of garlic.
units: Bets. 12ᵇ מהו לפָרוּכֵי וכ׳ dare one husk by rubbing and eat the seeds?; a. e.—Trnsf. to refute, raise an objection.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 13a:3">Kidd. 13ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>פ׳ רב אחא וכ׳</he> Rab A. objected &c.
Ned. 51ᵃ כל … פָּרְכָהּ וכ׳ whatever interpretation of toʿebah Rabbi offered, Bar Ḳ. refuted it.
<cite ref="Sotah 7a:14">Sot. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ופָרְכוּהָ</he> Rashi a. Tosaf. (ed. <he>ופֵירְכוּהָ</he> Hebr. form) and he refuted it.

senses.gloss: , אִיפְּרִיךְ to be crushed; to be dry, parched, easily peeled.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 24:7">Targ. Is. XXIV, 7</cite> (h. text <he>אמלל׳</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 90:5">Targ. Ps. XC, 5</cite>.
Ib. LXXX, 17 מִיפַּרְכָא Ms. (ed. מופרכא, corr. acc.; ed. Wil. מְפָרְכָא Part. pass. Pa.; h. text כסוחה).—[Targ. Y. II, Num. XXXIII, 52, v. supra.]—
<cite ref="Shabbat 20b:12">Sabb. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>אִיפָּרוּכֵי מִפָּרְכָן</he> (or <he>מְפָרְכָן</he>) they are brittle (unfit to be twisted into wicks).
Pes. 68ᵇ, v. supra; a. e.—Trnsf. to be refuted.

<cite ref="Horayot 14a:5">Hor. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>כל דאמר מילתא ולא מִיפְּרַךְ וכ׳</he> whoever will say something and not be refuted, let him be the chief; <he>דכולהו אִיפְּרִיךְ וכ׳</he> what every one of them said was refuted, what A. said was not; a. e.
